flagged.evidence: The proof defines “$R_\ell=C_\ell^*$” and then states “$J=I_{n_{k+1}}\otimes R_{k+1}$” in the product $L_kM_{k+1}J$, with $M_{k+1}$ having columns indexed by $(i_{k+1},\alpha_{k+1})$. Since $R_{k+1}$ has shape (suffix size) by $r_{k+1}$, this $J$ has shape $n_{k+1}(\text{suffix size})$ by $n_{k+1}r_{k+1}$, so the displayed product is not dimensionally compatible in general. Also, $R_{k+1}^*R_{k+1}=I$ implies $J^*J=I$, not the claimed $JJ^*=I$. Using $I_{n_{k+1}}\otimes R_{k+1}^*$ would give the needed dimensions and identity; this appears to be a readily correctable adjoint typo.
